Message:
ftrace: Remove unused global 'ftrace_direct_func_count'

Commit 8788ca164eb4b ("ftrace: Remove the legacy _ftrace_direct API")
stopped setting the 'ftrace_direct_func_count' variable, but left
it around.  Clean it up.
